This page contains links to my Colab/Jupyter notebooks, as well as useful paid and free online resources. Also, see my GitHub Repo here: [https://github.com/DataHurdler/UdemyPracticeCode](https://github.com/DataHurdler/UdemyPracticeCode).

## Project Notebooks

### Simple TF-IDF Movie Recommender
[Link to Google Colab Notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1IyGtr3oqEcx8f5hVUtfmEd9Ko0adxaic?usp=sharing)  
This is an exercise from Section 2 of Udemy's *Machine Learning: Natural Language Processing in Python* by the [Lazy Programmer](https://lazyprogrammer.me/). The exercise builds a movie recommender with ONLY TF-IDF (no learning).

### Time Series Analysis of Movie Sales in Shanghai
[Link to Google Colab Notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1ufhhpase57Ic8jfsdK2YI4NFkR6DUjRg?usp=sharing)  
I analyze movie sales in Shanghai from 2012-2015 with exponential smoothing (from [statsmodels](https://www.statsmodels.org/dev/generated/statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters.ExponentialSmoothing.html)) and [Facebook's Prophet](http://facebook.github.io/prophet/). The data is reduced from the one used in my research paper "[The impact of air pollution on movie theater admissions](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jeem.2022.102626)".
